clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits Mistral AI to use Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback, without an intellectual-property-based or other obligation, royalty, or restriction. The object is the Feedback and associated Customer Data and Output, not all Customer Data or Output.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits copying Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits disclosure of Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits licensing Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback. This is distinct from the service-provider sublicensing right in Section 4.1.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits distribution of Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 2.4 permits Mistral AI to exploit Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback in any manner.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_provides_feedback means Customer provides Feedback to Mistral AI in connection with use of the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.1 declares that, to the extent permitted by applicable law, Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and owns Output, with Mistral AI assigning any right, title, and interest it may have in Output. It excludes Mistral AI Product components and third-party content from Output. The ownership allocation and assignment are operative but do not themselves state an activity permission or prohibition expressible by the supplied activity set.
clauses.condition_explanation: applicable_law_permits means the ownership statements apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law. No use permission is inferred from the ownership declaration.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.2 concerns providing Customer Data through the Customer Account, including End User Accounts. Customer represents and warrants that it has and will maintain every right, license, and permission required for that provision.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_has_and_maintains_all_required_rights_licenses_and_permissions means Customer has and continues to maintain all rights, licenses, and permissions required to provide the Customer Data to the Mistral AI Products.

obligation_items.content: Have and maintain all rights, licenses, and permissions required to provide Customer Data to the Mistral AI Products.
obligation_items.object: Customer Data provided through the Customer Account, including End User Accounts
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer provides Customer Data to the Mistral AI Products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.2 places responsibility on Customer for all use of Outputs and for evaluating them for improper bias, accuracy, responsiveness, and appropriateness for Customer's use case. The evaluation duty is separately captured below.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_is_responsible_for_all_output_use means Customer bears responsibility for all use of Outputs, including use by End Users as provided by the Customer Responsibilities definition.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.2 prohibits Customer from representing or implying that Output generated by the Mistral AI Products was generated by a human.
clauses.condition_explanation: output_was_generated_by_mistral_ai_products means the Output at issue was generated by the Mistral AI Products.

obligation_items.content: Do not represent or imply that Output generated by the Mistral AI Products was generated by a human.
obligation_items.object: Output generated by the Mistral AI Products
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer represents or implies the origin of such Output.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.2 makes Customer solely responsible for Output generated if Customer deactivates filters that Mistral AI may provide for certain products. This records the responsibility, not a general permission or requirement to deactivate filters.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_deactivates_output_filters means Customer deactivates filters provided for a Mistral AI Product.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.2 expressly makes Customer solely responsible for evaluating Output for improper bias, accuracy, responsiveness, and appropriateness for Customer's use case.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_evaluates_output_for_bias_accuracy_responsiveness_and_appropriateness means Customer evaluates Output against each listed quality and suitability criterion.

obligation_items.content: Evaluate Output for improper bias, accuracy, responsiveness, and appropriateness for Customer's use case.
obligation_items.trigger: In connection with Customer's use of Output.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.3 prohibits use of image Outputs to develop or train an image-generation product that competes with a Mistral AI Product, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
clauses.condition_explanation: applicable_law_permits_the_restriction means the prohibition applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law. image_output_used_to_develop_or_train_competing_image_generation_product means the image Output is used for development or training of an image-generation product that competes with a Mistral AI Product.

obligation_items.content: Do not use image Outputs to develop or train an image-generation product that competes with a Mistral AI Product.
obligation_items.trigger: To the extent permitted by applicable law, whenever the proposed use is to develop or train a competing image-generation product.

clauses.scope_note: Section 3.5 advises Customer to verify Output's reliability, accuracy, and completeness before relying on it for any purpose or otherwise making it available to third parties. It also says Customer should not rely on Output as the sole source of truth or as a substitute for professional advice. These are expressed as cautions, not categorical prohibitions.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_relies_on_output_or_makes_output_available_to_third_parties means either relying on Output for any purpose or making it available to a third party. Verification means checking reliability, accuracy, and completeness before that reliance or availability.

obligation_items.content: Verify the reliability, accuracy, and completeness of Output before relying on it or making it available to third parties.
obligation_items.trigger: Before relying on Output for any purpose or otherwise making it available to a third party.

obligation_items.content: Do not rely on Output as the sole source of truth or as a substitute for professional advice.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.1 grants Mistral AI a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable except as permitted by Section 14.2, royalty-free, fully paid license to use Customer Data and Outputs to provide, maintain, and optimize the Mistral AI Products (including debugging, assessing, reviewing, and correcting their performance, but excluding model training) and to perform obligations under the Terms or Additional Terms. Sublicensing is limited to service providers. Section 14.2 is not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: The use must be for either the listed product purposes or performance of obligations under the Terms or Additional Terms; model training is excluded from this license.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.2 prohibits Mistral AI from using Customer Data or Outputs to train its AI models except in the five stated circumstances.
clauses.condition_explanation: The alternatives are: Customer opted in on an opt-out-by-default product; Customer did not opt out on an opt-in-by-default product; Customer or an End User provided Feedback; an Order Form provides otherwise; or Customer uses Labs or Preview Models.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Customer Data or Outputs to train Mistral AI models except in a circumstance expressly listed in Section 4.2.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Mistral AI would use Customer Data or Outputs for model training and none of the five stated exceptions applies.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.2 grants Mistral AI a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable except as permitted by Section 14.2, royalty-free, fully paid license to train its AI models using Customer Data and Outputs solely in the stated circumstances, with sublicensing to service providers. Section 14.2 is not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: Any one of the five Section 4.2 alternatives permits training, subject to applicable product opt-in/opt-out settings and the stated limitation.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.3 states Labs or Preview Models are exclusively available to Mistral AI's commercial Customers and restricted to professional use only.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_is_not_a_commercial_customer_or_use_is_not_professional means Customer is not a Mistral AI commercial Customer or the use is not professional.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Labs or Preview Models unless Customer is a Mistral AI commercial Customer and the use is professional.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer considers using a Labs or Preview Model.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.3 makes experimental, preview, or pre-release Labs or Preview Models available to commercial Customers for testing, restricted to professional use.
clauses.condition_explanation: Customer must be a Mistral AI commercial Customer, the use professional, and the use for testing purposes.

clauses.scope_note: Section 4.3 says Mistral AI may use Customer Data and Outputs generated from Labs or Preview Models to train its models, and opt-out preferences selected for other products, including zero data retention, do not apply. It advises customers who do not want training use not to use these models.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use is subject to possible training use of its data and Outputs and does not carry over opt-out preferences for other products.

clauses.scope_note: Section 5.1 reserves Mistral AI's ownership of the Mistral AI Products and says Customer receives only the limited use right explicitly granted in the Terms and applicable Additional Terms, with other rights reserved. It does not independently specify an activity permission; no broader grant is inferred.
clauses.condition_explanation: Any Customer use right must be found in an express grant in the Terms or applicable Additional Terms.

coverage_notes: Section 2.4's Feedback-related grant is limited to Feedback and Customer Data and Output associated with that Feedback; it does not grant unrestricted use of all Customer Data or Outputs.
Section 3.1 ownership and assignment declarations and Section 5.1 reservation of rights are not themselves activity permissions or prohibitions expressible by the supplied activity set.
Section 4.1 and 4.2 refer to Section 14.2, which is not supplied. Additional Terms and Order Forms may also affect the stated scope; their contents are not supplied.

Section 4.2 training exceptions are alternatives, not cumulative. Section 4.3 states that Labs or Preview Model data and Outputs may be used for training notwithstanding opt-out preferences for other products.
Section 6.1–6.2 define Confidential Information and its exclusions; the supplied paragraphs do not establish additional behavior rules. The definition context supplied separately is not citable.
